items.comment: This 10-Q discloses no intended or agreed investment amount in OpenAI. What it discloses are credit-support guarantees for OpenAI-affiliated data center leases (SB Energy, capped at $105 billion) and generic aggregate equity investment commitments ($25 billion) that are not attributed to OpenAI.

new_facts.topic: SB Energy guarantees for OpenAI-affiliated leases

fragments.text: SB Energy Corp. guarantees – In August 2026, we entered into guarantees, capped at a total of $ 105 billion, to provide credit support on a land, power, and shell buildout with affiliates of SB Energy Corp. (SB Energy) on behalf of a customer, an affiliate of OpenAI Group PBC (OpenAI), related to leases for approximately 4.25 gigawatts of IT load in the aggregate at SB Energy’s PORTS Technology Campus in Pike County, Ohio.

new_facts.why_it_matters: Adds maximum gross exposure on OpenAI-related infrastructure that sits alongside the intended investment, and the guarantees begin only as each data center phase is placed in service.

new_facts.topic: MOUs for $500bn third-party AI infrastructure financing platforms

fragments.text: In August 2026, we entered into memorandums of understanding with several large capital providers to establish independent financing platforms designed to mobilize more than $500 billion of third-party capital over time to support the deployment of AI infrastructure.
At our option, we may provide limited residual-value support for a portion of specific projects, subject to disciplined risk management and project-by-project evaluation.

new_facts.why_it_matters: Shows a push to move AI infrastructure funding off Nvidia's own balance sheet, but as preliminary arrangements that may not become definitive agreements and may carry residual-value support.

new_facts.topic: Supply and capacity commitments jump to $279bn

fragments.text: We have significantly increased our supply and capacity commitments from $119 billion last quarter to $279 billion as of July 26, 2026 to meet future demand.

new_facts.why_it_matters: The scale of committed supply spending is the demand-side counterpart to the data center revenue and to any customer-financing support.

fragments.text: These include equity investments of $99 billion and equity investment commitments of $25 billion as of July 26, 2026.
Equity investments – We committed to make certain equity investments in AI model makers, infrastructure financiers, and other private companies, subject to certain contingencies.

new_facts.why_it_matters: Quantifies the ecosystem investment channel (including AI model makers and infrastructure financiers) through which a future OpenAI investment would be made.

new_facts.topic: June 2026 debt issuance and commercial paper capacity

fragments.text: In June 2026, we issued an aggregate of $ 25.0 billion of senior unsecured notes across seven tranches for general corporate purposes.
As of July 26, 2026, our commercial paper program had a capacity of $ 25.0 billion, with no amounts outstanding.

new_facts.why_it_matters: Funding raised for general corporate purposes expands the capital available for investments, commitments and credit support.
